description: Wait for a run sent with dsh_send to end and return its state and final reply. Prefer the background wait_command from dsh_send if your client wakes you when a background command exits: it costs no turns. It also returns at once when the run stops to ask a person: needs_input answer (question and relay; reply with dsh_answer) or harness-ui (an approval only a person can give in Harness). Each call waits up to 50 s; if it returns timed_out: true, call dsh_wait again with the same run_id, without a progress note.
name: dsh_wait
